title: Professional Certificate Course in Conceptual Construct of Marketing Communication
description: The learners will have a thorough understanding of Marketing Communication and will be able to apply this knowledge to develop and implement successful marketing campaigns.
longDescription: Advertising and Strategy. Advertising Models and Concepts. Public Relations. Publics or Stakeholders. Crisis Management. The aim of this course is to equip learners with the knowledge and skills required to create effective marketing communication strategies. By the end of the course, learners will have a thorough understanding of the different disciplines and approaches to marketing communication and will be able to apply this knowledge to develop and implement successful marketing campaigns. Learners will also gain an understanding of the role of communication in managing stakeholder relationships, crisis management, and sponsorship. This course will help learners develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, as well as enhance their creativity and communication abilities. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This course provides an overview of the various disciplines and approaches to marketing communication. The course focuses on advertising and strategy, advertising models and concepts, public relations, publics or stakeholders, crisis management, and sponsorship. Learners will learn about the principles and practices of each of these disciplines and how they can be applied to create effective marketing communication campaigns.
